question: What is the name of Arunachal Pradesh's first greenfield airport?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Donyi Polo Airport.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• PM Narendra Modi inaugurated the Donyi Polo Airport at Itanagar in Arunachal Pradesh on 19 November 2022.
 
• It is the first Greenfield Airport in the state.
 
• It is equipped with ultra-modern facilities to ensure all-weather operations.
 
• The name of the airport is given after Donyi and Polo, i.e. Sun and Moon.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] Additional Information__

 
• ​Arunachal Pradesh is popularly known as the Land of the Dawn-lit Mountains.
 
• Arunachal Pradesh is India's remotest state and the first Indian state to greet the rising sun.
 
• It was formed from the erstwhile North-East Frontier Agency region and became a state on 20 February 1987.
 
• It borders the states of Assam and Nagaland to the south.
 
• Solung is the most popular festival of the Adis of Arunachal Pradesh which is celebrated on September 1 every year.
 
 
• Capital: Itanagar 
 
• Chief minister: Pema Khandu
